title: Supreme Court directs immediate FIR registration for every missing person
summary: The Supreme Court has emphasised that an FIR must be registered immediately in every missing-person case irrespective of the person's age or gender, stressing the need for prompt police action and effective investigation.

title: Supreme Court indicates Sabarimala reference verdict may come by October 6
summary: While considering the challenge to the Bodh Gaya Temple Act, the Supreme Court indicated that the nine-judge Constitution Bench verdict in the Sabarimala reference may be delivered by October 6, 2026.

title: Supreme Court directs Centre to consider mechanism against illegal AI-generated and doxxing content
summary: The Supreme Court directed the Union Government to consider a mechanism for urgent reporting and URL-specific disabling of access to unlawful online content, including threats of violence, doxxing, unauthorised disclosure of private information and non-consensual AI-generated material.

title: Supreme Court considers challenge to clinical establishment pricing rules
summary: The Union Government defended Rule 9(ii) of the Clinical Establishments Rules before the Supreme Court, arguing that prescribed price ranges can help standardise medical charges and prevent excessive or arbitrary pricing.

title: Supreme Court clarifies presumption in insider trading cases involving UPSI
summary: The Supreme Court held that possession of unpublished price-sensitive information coupled with trading during the relevant UPSI period can attract the statutory presumption under the SEBI insider-trading framework, setting aside the Securities Appellate Tribunal's approach.

title: Supreme Court explains four-step test for quashing criminal proceedings using defence material
summary: The Supreme Court reiterated that criminal proceedings may exceptionally be quashed before trial where defence material is unimpeachable, directly rules out the prosecution's factual allegations and demonstrates that continuation of the case would amount to abuse of process.

title: Supreme Court says alibi need not always wait until trial
summary: The Supreme Court held that there is no inflexible rule preventing courts from considering reliable documentary material establishing an accused's absence from the scene at the pre-trial stage when such material is unimpeachable.

title: Supreme Court asks States to consider notifying cancer as a notifiable disease
summary: The Supreme Court has asked States and Union Territories that have not notified cancer as a notifiable disease to consider doing so, in proceedings concerning the need for a uniform national reporting mechanism.

title: Supreme Court refuses to interfere with restrictions on Trinamool Congress bank accounts
summary: The Supreme Court declined to interfere with restrictions imposed by the Calcutta High Court on certain Trinamool Congress bank accounts frozen by the Enforcement Directorate in connection with a money-laundering investigation.

title: Supreme Court considers West Bengal SIR appellate tribunal timeline
summary: The Supreme Court considered issues concerning the timeline for appellate tribunals in the West Bengal Special Intensive Revision process and sought data relating to disposal of appeals.

title: BCI asks State Bar Councils to prepare panel of four women members for co-option
summary: The Bar Council of India has asked State Bar Councils to meet on August 16 to prepare panels of four women members for co-option, with the panels to be forwarded to the Chief Justices of the respective High Courts.

title: Supreme Court seeks Union response on plea concerning fake advocates
summary: The Supreme Court issued notice to the Union Government on a plea seeking a CBI investigation into alleged fake advocates and measures concerning monetisation of judicial remarks and related issues.

title: Delhi High Court asks judges to provide PAN and tax-return details
summary: The Delhi High Court directed Private Secretaries of Supreme Court and High Court judges who filed returns under the new tax regime to furnish PAN and return particulars in proceedings concerning taxation of judicial allowances.

title: Delhi High Court refuses interim entry to OCI cardholder facing blacklisting
summary: The Delhi High Court refused interim relief to an elderly OCI cardholder facing blacklisting over alleged anti-India activities, in proceedings concerning entry into India and the legal consequences of blacklisting.

title: Delhi High Court orders takedown of obscene content concerning actress Janhvi Kapoor
summary: The Delhi High Court considered a plea concerning obscene online content involving actress Janhvi Kapoor and indicated that takedown directions could be issued while questioning whether blanket restrictions against fan pages were appropriate.

title: Gujarat High Court says private card games without profit-making element are not gambling offence
summary: The Gujarat High Court considered whether playing cards for money inside a home, without a profit-making element, constitutes an offence under the applicable gambling legislation.

title: Calcutta High Court says adult victims can freely spend compensation
summary: The Calcutta High Court held that legal-services authorities should not adopt an overprotective approach toward adult victims and considered the victim's autonomy in spending compensation awarded under victim-compensation schemes.

title: Bombay High Court extends low-attendance protection to law students of all semesters
summary: The Bombay High Court considered the scope of the Supreme Court's one-time protection from detention for law students facing attendance shortages and held that the protection is not confined only to final-year students.

title: Allahabad High Court confirms bank can proceed directly against guarantor
summary: The Allahabad High Court held that a bank can recover loan dues directly from a guarantor without first exhausting remedies against the principal borrower, reaffirming the independent nature of a guarantor's contractual liability.

title: Punjab and Haryana High Court grants bail in UAPA case involving alleged pro-Khalistan slogans
summary: The Punjab and Haryana High Court granted bail to a man accused under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act in connection with allegations concerning pro-Khalistan slogans painted on a government building.

title: Delhi High Court questions transfer plea based on judge's oral remarks
summary: The Delhi High Court imposed costs in proceedings where a litigant sought transfer of a case following oral observations attributed to the presiding judge, addressing the standards required for seeking transfer of judicial proceedings.

title: Rajasthan High Court examines legal status of an 'adopted son-in-law'
summary: The Rajasthan High Court considered whether the expression 'adopted son-in-law' has a recognised legal status, examining the statutory and legal consequences attached to family relationships and adoption.

title: Chhattisgarh High Court denies bail in CGPSC examination paper leak case
summary: The Chhattisgarh High Court denied bail to a former CGPSC secretary in an examination paper leak case, stressing the serious impact of examination malpractice on the careers of aspirants.

title: Madras High Court rules disability reservation cannot be claimed for government-lawyer engagement
summary: The Madras High Court considered whether reservation for persons with disabilities applies to engagement as government counsel and addressed the distinction between public employment and professional engagement.

title: Kerala High Court says POCSO case against father cannot be settled by mother
summary: The Kerala High Court held that a prosecution under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act concerning alleged sexual assault of a minor child cannot simply be settled or withdrawn through a compromise between the mother and the accused father.

title: Madras High Court questions denial of permit for anti-NEET and EWS bike rally
summary: The Madras High Court questioned restrictions on a proposed bike rally concerning NEET and EWS issues and emphasised that State authorities cannot arbitrarily suppress citizens' lawful expressive activities.

title: Delhi High Court considers PMLA proceedings after predicate offence was quashed
summary: The Delhi High Court considered whether a money-laundering prosecution under the PMLA automatically disappears when the underlying predicate offence has been quashed on the basis of compromise, examining the independent statutory framework of money laundering.

title: Allahabad High Court criticises repeated adjournments and online criticism of courts
summary: The Allahabad High Court criticised a pattern in which litigants seek adjournments and subsequently criticise courts for delay, highlighting the responsibility of parties and lawyers in efficient case management.

title: Calcutta High Court permits Jamiat rally with attendance cap
summary: The Calcutta High Court permitted a Jamiat-e-Ulama rally concerning the removal of loudspeakers from mosques while imposing a limit on attendance, balancing public-order considerations with the right to assemble.

title: Punjab and Haryana High Court applies Section 45 PMLA bail exception to women without status-based distinction
summary: The Punjab and Haryana High Court considered the special bail exception available to women under Section 45 of the PMLA and emphasised that the provision does not distinguish between women based on education, profession or social status.

title: Allahabad High Court says police cannot refuse sexual-harassment FIR merely for lack of evidence
summary: The Allahabad High Court held that police cannot refuse to register an FIR in a sexual-harassment complaint merely because the complainant has not produced evidence at the initial stage, stressing that investigation is the appropriate mechanism for collecting evidence.

title: Punjab and Haryana High Court commutes death penalty in rape-murder case to 50 years imprisonment
summary: The Punjab and Haryana High Court considered the proportionality of punishment in a rape-murder case involving a seven-year-old child and commuted the death sentence while directing a lengthy fixed period of imprisonment.

title: Madras High Court defers framing of charge in cash-for-vote case
summary: The Madras High Court deferred framing of charges in the cash-for-vote case involving BJP leader Nainar Nagendran and others, continuing judicial scrutiny of the criminal proceedings.
